title: Environmental challenges of disposable wipes: causes, impacts, and sustainable solutions
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,4936-4954
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00408J, Critical Review
Open Access

Md Shakirul Islam, Merin Jahan Sabiha, Alireza Vahedi Fakhr, Joseph Odey, Tarikul Islam
Environmental concerns from wipe disposal are closely tied to the material composition and construction of wipes. Mindful material selection with optimized process engineering is pivotal in shaping the next generation of sustainable wipes.
